name: Plasma Wave
description: Full-container WebGL2 background of two glowing intertwined plasma ribbons with bloom, film grain and a pointer-driven swell and lens glow, with an intro fade-in.
contents: Container div holding a single WebGL canvas that fills it
behavior: Raymarched twin ribbons animate continuously with wobble
Intro fades the ribbons in over 1.8 seconds
Pointer over the container swells the ribbons near the cursor and adds a lens glow
Renders only while visible and tab is active
Bloom and coarse-to-fine rendering with pixel cap for performance
Light mode renders opaque ink-like ribbons for light pages
editableByProps: Animation speed, per-ribbon speed and direction, bend, thickness
Camera focal length, rotation and offset
Brightness, glow, core, grain, opacity, edge fade
Quality, pixel ratio, pause, intro and mouse interaction toggles
Container classes and extra div attributes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change bloom strength levels or depth
Change ribbon shape or number of ribbons

fixed: Needs WebGL2; renders nothing if unsupported or shaders fail
Fills its parent, so the parent must have a defined height
Pointer listener is attached to window and tracks the whole page
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by disabling motion, intro and pointer effect
Device pixel ratio capped at 2 and light pixels capped at 2.4M, so large screens render at lower resolution
Heavy shader, may be slow on low-end mobile; lower quality prop helps
Settings other than quality and dpr update live without re-creating the context
